discussion.body:
Source continent plate logged as Master-Map-Alpha-A0.1.jpg. No status change. HEAD not moved.
This is the FEAT-005 master map (World Map - Master). Layout, polity names, six temples, World Cannon / Maze Fissure, King's Sea, Orc Invasion, and the scale bar are canon distance. Towns on this plate are real stops.
SET-1.2 height / cities / terrain / political layers were derived from this plate. They are planning overlays, not a replacement for Alpha-A0.1.
Local file: asteria-map-layers/Master-Map-Alpha-A0.1.jpg (4085x4096 JPEG).
